defaults.style: Style: high-end luxury watch editorial photography, shot on a medium-format camera with a 100mm macro lens, natural soft directional light, shallow depth of field, rich deep forest-green (#0f2320), warm cream (#f9f6ef) and brushed gold (#c9a961) palette, refined and understated, photorealistic, accurate mechanical watch anatomy (correct crown, lugs, bezel, hands and indices). No visible brand names, logos, watermarks or legible text on dials or anywhere in the frame.

styles.product: Style: professional luxury e-commerce product photograph. A single watch, centred, on a seamless, very pale warm off-white paper sweep (close to #f3ede0: nearly neutral, never yellow, golden or orange) with a soft, even graduated falloff. Large diffused softbox key light from the upper left, gentle fill from the right, a soft natural contact shadow beneath the watch. Tack-sharp focus across the whole watch, accurate reflections on the sapphire crystal and polished metal, true-to-life metal colours. The watch fills about 70% of the frame. Photorealistic, catalogue quality, consistent with a matching set of product photos. Accurate mechanical watch anatomy (correct crown, lugs, bezel, hands and indices). No brand names, logos, wordmarks, watermarks or legible text on the dial or anywhere in the frame.
